HEALTH ECONOMICS & OUTCOMES RESEARCH SUMMARY
Moderna, Inc. | Market Access

Product: mRNA-1273 (Spikevax)
Indication: Prevention of COVID-19 in Adults
Audience: Payer / Formulary Committee
Date: 23 May 2026
Author: Michael Smith, HEOR Director
1. Disease Burden
COVID-19 continues to impose a significant health and economic burden in the United States. Annual hospitalizations attributable to COVID-19 are estimated at 231,018, with direct medical costs exceeding $12 billion. Indirect costs including productivity losses add an estimated $56 billion annually.

3. Cost-Effectiveness Analysis
Model Type: Markov Model — Decision Analytic Framework
Time Horizon: 10-year
Perspective: US Payer (Commercial Insurance)
Discount Rate: 3% for costs and outcomes
ICER: $6,222 per QALY gained
WTP Threshold: $100,000 per QALY (common US threshold)
Conclusion: Cost-effective at standard US willingness-to-pay thresholds
4. Budget Impact Analysis
Plan Size Modeled: 1,000,000 covered lives
Vaccination Rate Assumed: 55%
Year 1 Net Budget Impact: $5M increase
Year 3 Cumulative Offset: $10M in avoided hospitalizations
5-Year Net Savings: $39M
5. Conclusion
mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) demonstrates strong clinical effectiveness and is cost-effective under standard US healthcare thresholds. The long-term budget impact is favorable when hospitalization and productivity costs are included. Moderna, Inc. recommends preferred formulary placement with no prior authorization restrictions.
